name: header-sticky
description: Sticky top navigation bar — logo, primary nav, CTA button, mobile drawer. Reads nav + brand from src/site.config.ts.

ai.whenToUse: Use as the persistent top navigation on every page. Reads nav links, logo, and primary CTA from `src/site.config.ts`; per-page overrides via content slots. Stays pinned on scroll with a subtle backdrop blur.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use with `header-transparent`. Don't place two headers on one page. For nav-less landing pages, omit headers entirely.

ctaText.description: Override the global CTA button label for this page. Falls back to `site.ctaPrimary.text`.

ctaHref.description: Override the global CTA button destination. Falls back to `site.ctaPrimary.href`.

ctaVariant.description: Visual treatment of the CTA: primary | secondary | ghost.

navAriaLabel.description: Accessibility label for the primary nav element (read by screen readers).

menuToggleAriaLabel.description: Accessibility label for the mobile hamburger button.
